# The Proof Wall

Independent research archive. Browse index.json, then each exhibit metadata URL. Read claim_scope, limitations, provenance, source hashes and version relations before reusing a claim. A publication check is not a proof checker.

- Index: index.json
- Gardens: gardens.json
- Schema: schema.json
- Contributions: contribute.html
- File hashes: release-manifest.json

No remote tools or write API. Contributions require review. Canonical home: https://aleksandrsolnatus.github.io/proof-wall/
